meta.desc: Home page of the apparel designer made 100% in Québec, made by TIM students with help from AI and brought to life with 100% biological and natural fibers

accueil.amorceH1: Teeshirts, hoodies, and caps, made in Québec 💯
accueil.amorceH4: /** with a little help from DALL-E 😉 **/
accueil.para1: Today, the teeshirt is an important piece of clothing in anyone's closet. And in an era where environmental questions are more prevalent than ever, we prefer teeshirts made in Québec, to reduce the environmental impact and to put forward local crafts.
accueil.para2: V-necks, round-necks, ample or adjusted, short or long sleeves for colder people, simple or patterned to stylize an outfit… The teeshirt is available in a variety of styles, colors and patterns.
